create_doge_config: create a DogeConfig instance with default Doge-320M model parameters
init_doge_model_from_config: initialize a DogeModel using a DogeConfig configuration object
configure_moe_experts: configure DogeConfig with mixture-of-experts settings including num_experts and num_experts_per_tok
set_attention_parameters: set DogeConfig attention parameters including num_attention_heads, num_key_value_heads, and sliding_window
configure_tensor_parallel_plan: configure DogeConfig tensor parallel and pipeline parallel distribution plans
